decision: feature the repair and remaining errors
methods: agent visual comparison of opening, draft and repaired frames
separate model critiques of draft and repaired pairs
observations: The opening establishes one cream robot with amber eye, blue limbs and orange satchel.
The draft duplicates the seedling; the repair leaves one planted seedling and an empty container and improves the crouching pose.
The fresh final reader flags remaining scene-continuity problems.
limitations: The hatch remains closed despite the next-beat requirement.
One fixed repair improves some errors without establishing full continuity.
A favorable model verdict alone was not used as acceptance.
